title: Corrupt Wood
body:
The Corrupted can be obtained by hitting any tree with one of the Mysterious Mushrooms' projectiles, meaning the Corrupted can come in various different shapes and sizes.

Obtaining

The method for obtaining Corrupted Wood is as follows:

- Take any tree (except for cactus, acacia, deadwood or palm) to Uncertainty Cave

- Allow the tree to be hit with a projectile from a Mysterious Mushroom

Trivia

- When hovered over, the name shows "Corrupted".

- This tree was added during the Halloween 2024 event, but is a permanent addition to the game.

- The Corrupted sells for a low amount of candy, and is best used for building.
